study_design: Case-control study with fingernail selenium measured at recruitment.
cohort_total_n_excerpt: selenium concentration, measured using neutron activation techniques, was successfully assayed for 300 case-control pairs
reason: The abstract reports associations with both overall prostate cancer risk and advanced prostate cancer risk. Advanced prostate cancer is an aggressive incident endpoint; the number of advanced cases is not reported.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Nail selenium concentration was not significantly associated with prostate cancer risk: men in the highest quartile of nail selenium had a slightly increased risk compared with men in the lowest quartile (OR 1.24, 95 CI, 0.73-2.10);
estimate_classifications.reason: This estimate explicitly concerns overall prostate cancer risk, not the separately reported advanced prostate cancer endpoint.

additional_estimates.comparison: Highest versus lowest quartile of fingernail selenium concentration
